Game Overview

At its heart, Pie Attack is a arcade game about unleash your pie-throwing skills against mischievous cake villains in a chaotic city blitz. Engage in pastry warfare as you strategically take aim, careful not to hit innocent old ladies. With the police overwhelmed, it’s up to you and your delicious arsenal to save the day in this scrumptious showdown!
